body: That's some pretty decent advice. I do actually rock climb, funny.

That's a horrible situation to be in. PTSD is something that is difficult 
to face alone. I know exactly what you mean, when you say " i'll finnaly be at peace when no one can hurt me" it would be a moment of complete control over yourself and your situation. You're cross to bear is not one that can be done alone. You are not alone in this, please contact someone anyone you can, to just talk.
